messages.text: BL-2055 🎵 in progress — A local seat's restart relaunches it only on the parcel it holds now - the launch script served an earlier parcel's stale override (BL-1963, then BL-1874) to the iq3 coder holding BL-1913 on 2026-10-06, and a released parcel's leftover claim-progress sidecar made the repeat guard restart the seat on the ticket it had just released
